decisions.boundary_condition: Use this as a soft preference, not an absolute requirement, because the evidence ranges from a direct requirement to a tentative request and a later verification question.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer hotels that include free breakfast.
decisions.condition: When evaluating or booking a hotel, treat free breakfast as a recurring included-service preference.
decisions.default_action: Prioritize or verify hotels with free breakfast when available; if breakfast is not listed, ask or check rather than assuming it is included.
decisions.exception_condition: Do not reject an otherwise suitable hotel solely for lacking free breakfast unless the user explicitly makes it required in the current booking; do not infer a full or high-quality breakfast requirement unless stated.
decisions.name: prefer_included_hotel_breakfast
decisions.preference_value: Prefer hotels that include free breakfast.
decisions.rationale: Multiple examples show the user asking for or verifying free hotel breakfast. The evidence supports a recurring soft included-service preference, but not an absolute requirement or any specific breakfast quality/type.

decisions.boundary_condition: Treat this as a reusable hotel-amenity preference, not a destination, date, price, restaurant/bar, or indoor/outdoor pool preference. Use it as soft unless the current request makes the amenities mandatory.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer hotels with a pool, hot tub, and fitness or exercise access.
decisions.condition: When selecting or evaluating hotel options.
decisions.default_action: Prioritize or verify hotels that offer all three amenities: a pool, a hot tub, and fitness or exercise access; clearly note if one is missing.
decisions.exception_condition: If otherwise suitable hotels do not offer all three amenities, present close matches while explicitly noting which of pool, hot tub, or fitness/exercise access is absent.
decisions.name: prefer_hotel_pool_hot_tub_fitness
decisions.preference_value: Prefer hotels with a pool, hot tub, and fitness or exercise access.
decisions.rationale: The examples consistently ask for hotel pool, hot tub, and exercise/fitness access. This is a reusable hotel-amenity preference. The indoor/outdoor pool detail appears in only one example and should not be generalized here.
